name: Pradeepti Sharma

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Pradeepti Sharma writes across poetry and fiction. Her Nagpur-based introduction to Kabita Live describes a path from banking to writing and interior design, alongside an interest in cooking and gardening. A 2019 contributor note for her serial story “Before the 7 vows” also connects her writing with a banking career and an enjoyment of art, literature and everyday creative activity.

In “Nostalgia”, a familiar street becomes a storehouse of shared experience. Cracked walls, a bakery, a florist and a wooden bench carry the memory of someone absent. The poem moves from the physical details of walking to an inward sense of companionship, ending with a solitude that does not feel empty.
